parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle or lever of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt depending on the faucet design, providing control over water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet that houses the internal valve mechanism and connects to the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the switch and spout, contains the internal water channels, and provides structural stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved tube extending from the faucet body, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the internal valve to the sink basin, often designed for optimal reach and flow.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
